_doc: Ad content for HomeTidy. Edit this file only; no code change is needed.
slots.banner = fixed bar at the bottom. slots.interstitial = full-screen window shown at most once a day (closable at once with x).
type 'image': {img, href, alt, width, height}. Image files can be in ads/ or on an allowed ad host (see CSP in index.html).
type 'html': {html}. Paste affiliate tags () from A8.net / Moshimo / Amazon Associates here.
lang: list of UI language codes ('ja','en',...) or ['*'] for all. weight: relative frequency. enabled:false = off.
Do not add wording that asks people to click ads.
